changeAnytime.question: Can I change plans anytime?
changeAnytime.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your subscription at any time. Changes take effect immediately for upgrades, and at the end of the current billing period for downgrades.

exceedLimits.question: What happens if I exceed my limits?
exceedLimits.answer: If you reach your plan's usage limits, you'll be notified and can either wait until the next billing cycle or upgrade to a higher plan for continued access.

dataSecure.question: Is my data secure?
dataSecure.answer: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption for all data storage and transmission. Your client information and generated content are private and never shared with third parties.

commissionsGuide.description: Understanding how affiliate commissions work, payment schedules, and subscription limits
commissionsGuide.monthlyPaymentDescription: Commission payments are processed automatically on the 1st of each month for the previous month's earnings.
commissionsGuide.activeSubscriptionDescription: You must maintain an active subscription to receive commission payments. Suspended or canceled subscriptions will pause commission payouts.
commissionsGuide.validPaymentDescription: Only affiliated users with valid Stripe subscriptions and payment methods are included in commission calculations.
commissionsGuide.calculationLimitsDescription: Your subscription plan determines how many users from your referral network can be included in commission calculations.
commissionsGuide.topPerformingReferrals: Commissions calculated from your top {{count}} performing referrals

commissionsGuide.note2: Payments are processed via Stripe to your registered payment method
commissionsGuide.note3: Commission calculations exclude trial users and inactive subscriptions
commissionsGuide.note4: Upgrade your subscription to increase your earning potential
commissionsGuide.paymentRules: Commissions are automatically processed and paid out monthly via the payment method associated with your account.
commissionsGuide.importantNotes: Important: Commissions are only calculated up to the 4th generation to maintain system sustainability.
